critical_code_review_comments: App.js correctly removes the /wedding-party route and WeddingPartyPage import. Good.

mock.js `navigationItems` matches the required 9 items in the correct order (OUR STORY, TIMELINE, CELEBRATION, GALLERY, TRAVEL & STAY, FAQ, REGISTRY, GUESTBOOK, RSVP). No WE DID IT / WEDDING PARTY link.

TravelPage embeds the '4450 Smoke Rise Road' destination inside the Google Maps iframe URL only. It is not rendered as visible page text on initial load; it only becomes visible after a hotel is selected ('Directions from <hotel> to 4450 Smoke Rise Road'). Recommend showing the destination address prominently as static text near the map so users see it without needing to click a hotel first.
Consider deleting dead code (`indiaLocation`, `weddingParty`, WeddingPartyPage.jsx) to reduce future confusion.
